entries.text: Hello, class! It is I, Hassel, yet again.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_03_dragon_01

entries.text: I’ve been told that my previous lecture about\nthe Terastal phenomenon was very well received.\r\nThank you all for your kind words![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_03_dragon_02

entries.text: In fact, Ms. Dendra specifically requested that\nI impart even more battle knowledge to\r\nmy students...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_03_dragon_03

entries.text: So, I have decided that today we will take\nanother look at how a Pokémon can Terastallize![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_03_dragon_04

entries.text: Gib gibble.
entries.label: class_f_03_poke_01

entries.text: And of course, here is Professor Gible to help us.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_03_dragon_05

entries.text: Now then, Professor Gible. If you would be so\nkind as to Terastallize for us...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_03_dragon_06

entries.text: Glaaam!
entries.label: class_f_03_poke_02

entries.text: Now, what do we have here? Last class we saw\nGrass-type Terastallizing, but this time we have\r\nsomething of a different shape.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_03_dragon_07

entries.text: Observe, a Tera Jewel resembling a snowflake!\nIts dendritic shape is stunning to behold.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_03_dragon_08

entries.text: It’s a little chilly standing so close to it...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_03_dragon_09

entries.text: So, class... What Tera Type do you imagine this\njewel might represent?[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_03_dragon_10

entries.text: The Water type
entries.label: class_f_03_select_01

entries.text: The Ice type
entries.label: class_f_03_select_02

entries.text: The Ghost type
entries.label: class_f_03_select_03

entries.label: class_f_03_dragon_answer_01

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Excellent, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!\nFull marks\r\nfor you![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_03_dragon_answer_02

entries.text:

Though

that

way, too![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_03_dragon_answer_03

entries.text: The reason there’s a snowflake shining above\nProfessor Gible’s head is simple—it is now\r\nan Ice type![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_03_dragon_11

entries.text: And because Professor Gible is currently the\nIce type...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_03_dragon_12

entries.text: Ice-type moves would not be very effective\nagainst it. Keep in mind, usually they would\r\ndeal quadruple damage to Gible![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_03_dragon_13

entries.text: Now, here’s some trivia about snowflakes:\nwhile snowflakes come in many different shapes\r\nand sizes, most are classified as hexagons![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_03_dragon_14

entries.text: Just think of it... Snowflakes fall from the sky,\ntaking similar shapes without anyone saying\r\nthey must.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_03_dragon_15

entries.text: Do you not feel the great mystery of nature?\nThe beautiful enigma we live in?![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_03_dragon_16

entries.text: *cough*\c\nAh, this is a bit of a tangent, but Mr. Jacq’s\nglasses are also hexagonal, aren’t they.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_03_dragon_17

entries.text: I almost forgot to mention that you can change\na Pokémon’s Tera Type at the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Treasure Eatery[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\r\nlocated in Medali.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_03_dragon_18

entries.text: Though I must say the cook there is a little...\nprickly—you’ll need to get on her good side if\r\nyou want her help.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_03_dragon_19

entries.text: Now, come prepared for next class, because it is\ntime for your midterm examination!\c\nThank you for today, Professor Gible.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_03_dragon_20

entries.text: Glam-gib.
entries.label: class_f_03_poke_03
